title.narrative: UNIDO - Promotion of Sustainable Circular Packaging
UNIDO - Promotion of Sustainable Circular Packaging

description.narrative: Inledningsfasen fokuserar på förberedande aktiviteter för att lägga den tekniska och institutionella grunden för en fullskalig insats. Projektet främjar införandet av cirkulära förpackningslösningar och förbättrad efterlevnad av nationella och internationella standarder, med fokus på små och medelstora företag, kvalitetsinfrastruktursinstitutioner samt viktiga aktörer inom industri och akademi. Resultaten av denna fas kommer att mynna ut i ett validerat projektdokument för fas 2.

The inception phase focuses on preparatory activities to lay the technical and institutional groundwork for a full-scale intervention. The project promotes the adoption of circular packaging solutions and improved compliance with national and international standards, targeting SMEs, quality infrastructure institutions, and key industry and academic actors. The results of this phase will culminate in a validated Project Document for Phase 2

The objective of the inception phase is to prepare a technically sound and validated Project Document for Phase 2, ensuring stakeholder participation and alignment with national priorities. This will be achieved through comprehensive assessments of value chains, packaging systems, market access requirements, and the national quality infrastructure, complemented by a gender analysis and participatory workshops. Ultimately, these efforts aim to lay the foundation for a full-scale intervention that enhances the competitiveness and sustainability of Guatemalas food sector by promoting circular packaging solutions that reduce food loss and strengthen compliance with national and international standards for improved market access.
